game.title: Dishonored
game.blurb: Stealth action game in which Corvo Attano, the Empress' bodyguard, escapes prison to find her daughter Emily and clear his name, from Arkane Studios, released 2012-09-25. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Corvo escapes prison and works through his targets one mission at a time. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Stealth, Ghost and No-Kill Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing missions unseen, killing few or no one, and playing without most powers.

chapters.title: Combat, Powers and Gadgets
chapters.summary: Assassinations, drop kills, possession, Wall of Light and weapon kills.

chapters.title: Collectibles and Upgrades
chapters.summary: Bone charms, Sokolov paintings, pickpocketing and equipment upgrades.

chapters.title: Dunwall City Trials (challenges)
chapters.summary: The separate challenge maps: Back Alley Brawl, Train Runner, Burglar, Kill Cascade and more.

chapters.title: The Knife of Dunwall
chapters.summary: The add-on story at the Rothwild Slaughterhouse and the Timsh estate, with its favours and chaos endings.

chapters.title: The Brigmore Witches
chapters.summary: The follow-on add-on story: breaking someone out of Coldridge Prison, favours, chaos endings and a coin goal.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs). Its Walkthrough and ten mission pages (for example "High Overseer Campbell" and "The Flooded District") are linked but not written; only "Achievements and trophies" and "Table of Contents" subpages exist. dishonored.fandom.com answers the API, with about 61 linked pages, including "The Knife of Dunwall", "The Brigmore Witches" and "Dunwall City Trials"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam has two apps named "Dishonored" (205100 and 217980), both with the same 80 achievements; 205100 was used, as the first store match. Its schema gives no game name, so whether it is sold as the Definitive Edition was not confirmed. 17 of 80 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. The add-on chapters are placed by the add-on names in the achievement text. "Parting Shot", "Breakout" and "Gangs of Dunwall" (71 to 73) name no add-on; they sit between the two add-on blocks and were put in The Brigmore Witches by position, which needs checking. "Back Home", "Big Boy" and "Wall of Flesh" name no mode and sit in combat.
